title: xDrip sometimes is not able to reconnect to tomato after not being connected for some time.
symptom: After not being connected for some time, the phone does not reconnect to the tomato sensor automatically. The phone sends a BT SCAN_REQ, the tomato answers with SCAN_RSP, but the phone does not send a connection request. Opening the phone triggers a connection within seconds.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. The reporter speculates that the autoconnect parameter (set to false) and not being bonded may be factors, but no conclusive cause is identified.
fix: No definitive fix is stated. The reporter changed autoconnect to true and planned to observe. A commenter suggests rescanning/reselecting the device and restarting the collector as a workaround.
evidence_quote: I was not bonded and in my code autoconnect was false. It has now changed to true. so I'll keep following.
